terms.definition: The device Camera2 HAL reports this capability as supported in its characteristics or stream maps.
Point & Shoot parity sweep successfully exercised this capability on a real device session.
A capture session could be created that includes this capability without immediate failure.
Percentage of HAL-advertised catalog cells that were proven in the parity sweep.
OEM score for how much advertised hardware is gated from third-party Camera2 apps (higher = more restrictive).
Combined physical sensor area of rear non-logical cameras; larger often correlates with better light gathering.
Android's standard camera API used by third-party apps — not the OEM's proprietary camera app.
The Android SDK/API level (and marketing version when known) running on the device during the parity sweep. Scores may differ after major OS updates.
Maintainer USB sweep published from the project's regression fleet.
User-submitted Full parity sweep that passed automated validation.
